Title: Select robust indicators based on missingness
Family: analytics

Compute missingness per indicator and keep indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30.

Available input files:

Required output files:
- outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv

Output requirements:

  - missing_rate must match the fraction of missing values in outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv.

  - Keep city_id, city_name, year, and only indicator columns with missing_rate <= 0.30.

import pandas as pd

# Load the city-indicator matrix
input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
meta_columns = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in meta_columns]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}

for col in indicator_columns:
    total = len(df)
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / total if total > 0 else 0.0
    missing_counts[col] = missing_count
    missing_rates[col] = missing_rate

# Determine which indicators to keep (missing_rate <= 0.30)
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_columns if missing_rates[col] <= 0.30]

# Build missingness report
report_rows = []
for col in indicator_columns:
    report_rows.append({
        "indicator": col,
        "missing_count": int(missing_counts[col]),
        "missing_rate": missing_rates[col],
        "kept": col in kept_indicators
    })

report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_rows)
report_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv", index=False)

# Build selected matrix: keep meta columns + kept indicators
selected_columns = meta_columns + kept_indicators
selected_df = df[selected_columns]
selected_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv", index=False)
</solution_file>
